# render_setting { #crossrepo.config.render_setting }

```python
crossrepo.config.render_setting(key, value)
```

Write one setting the way a configuration file spells it.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**key**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Setting name.

<code>[**value**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Its value, a list of strings or a number.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The setting as TOML, ending in a newline. A list goes on one line when it is empty and one entry to a line otherwise, which is how [](`crossrepo.config.Config.write_default`) writes it and what keeps a diff to the entries that changed.
